Specialist Teaching 8 Wraparound Care We run a Breakfast Club every morning that runs from 7:45am – the start of school and costs £7 per day.

signals.text: Ralph Demeger Headteacher 3 Our Vision & Values Our School Vision In our school family, every person will flourish and become a shining light, through living out our Faith, being a Hope-bringer in times of darkness and showing God’s love to all.

Guided by our motto, “Be a shining light”, we aim to provide an education that goes beyond academics, nurturing knowledgeable, articulate, and inspired individuals who can make a positive difference in their community and the wider world.
Our School Values of love, thankfulness, peace, hope, self-control, honesty, humility, forgiveness, courage, empathy and faith shape everything we do at St John’s.
We are a friendly, diverse and inclusive school in Lewisham, with a strong sense of community and belonging.

4 Admissions We are a warm, inclusive school with strong links to St John’s Church, offering 15 foundation places (for children with a Christian faith connection) and 15 open places (for all children, regardless of faith or background).You do not need to be a Christian to attend St John’s.

A very warm welcome to St John's.
If you are interested in joining our school community, please click here to take a look at our school prospectus.
We are running the following open Prospective Parent/Carer Open Mornings to give families more information about what makes St John's such a special place.
Please click on the date below to sign up via our Eventbrite page:
- Tuesday 3rd November at 9:15
We also run weekly tours with the Headteacher every Tuesday at 10:40am giving families the opportunity to visit our school, see learning in action and experience the warm community at St John’s.
To book a tour, please call 0208 698 3059 or email admin@sjb.lewisham.sch.uk
To apply for a Reception place at St John’s for September 2027, please click here. If you are applying for an in-year school place, please click here.
We look forward to welcoming you to St John’s.
